phases.name: Research & discovery
phases.description: Understand users, stakeholder goals and the evidence behind the problem.

ai_actions.name: Synthesize research
ai_actions.description: Summarise saved research evidence, distinguish observations from assumptions, and propose findings for the research form. Never invent interviews or quotations.

phases.name: Define & prioritise
phases.description: Agree which problems to solve, for whom, and how success will be measured.

ai_actions.name: Draft product strategy
ai_actions.description: Draft a problem statement, priorities and measurable outcomes from the saved research. Propose strategy form fields and mark assumptions.

phases.name: Flows & structure
phases.description: Map journeys, information architecture and alternatives before visual detail.

ai_actions.name: Explore user journeys
ai_actions.description: Read the research and strategy, then propose core journeys, alternatives, error states and accessibility considerations in the flows form.

phases.name: Interface & prototype
phases.description: Define screens, reusable components and design decisions with references to the prototype.

ai_actions.name: Draft interface specifications
ai_actions.description: Draft interface specifications from saved journeys and design notes. Propose interface fields, distinguish confirmed tokens from suggestions, and flag missing prototype evidence.

phases.name: Test & iterate
phases.description: Review observed usability evidence, prioritise problems and record decisions.

checklist.text: Priority issues resolved or explicitly accepted

ai_actions.name: Analyse usability findings
ai_actions.description: Analyse saved usability observations, prioritise issues with evidence, and propose validation fields and follow-up tasks. Do not fabricate test sessions or claim a test passed.

phases.name: Build handoff
phases.description: Give the implementation team clear specifications, decisions and outstanding work.

checklist.text: Acceptance criteria reviewed with implementation team

ai_actions.name: Prepare build handoff
ai_actions.description: Read saved project forms and documents, then propose a build handoff with acceptance criteria, dependencies and open questions. Do not claim implementation, testing or release occurred.

handoffs.description: Reviewed research evidence inform define & prioritise.
Reviewed product strategy inform flows & structure.
Reviewed journeys and information architecture inform interface & prototype.
Reviewed interface specifications inform test & iterate.
Reviewed usability findings inform build handoff.
